title: Cancel orphans running separation subprocess
description: cancel_job() sent SIGTERM only to the worker PID; the demucs/audio-separator child kept running (burning GPU, writing to a deleted temp dir). FIXED in PR #6 (commit 1b81df5): worker is spawned with start_new_session=True so its PID is the process-group leader; cancel now os.killpg()s the group, verified mid-Stage-1 and mid-Stage-2 with no survivors. Close when PR #6 merges.
notes: Fix implemented and verified on branch ultra-quality-preset (commit 1b81df5); close when PR #6 merges.
close_reason: Fixed in PR #6 (merged): torchcodec pin 4aafdd8, process-group kill 1b81df5

title: Demucs FLAC output fails without torchcodec (torch 2.9)
description: torchaudio 2.9's save() delegates to torchcodec; without it demucs completes separation then exits non-zero writing FLAC/WAV (MP3 unaffected — lameenc). Symptom: tqdm hits 100%, stems dir created but empty. FIXED in PR #6 (commit 4aafdd8) by pinning torchcodec==0.9.* (torch-2.9-compatible per pytorch/torchcodec table) in install.sh. Close when PR #6 merges.
notes: Fix implemented and verified on branch ultra-quality-preset (commit 4aafdd8); close when PR #6 merges.
close_reason: Fixed in PR #6 (merged): torchcodec pin 4aafdd8, process-group kill 1b81df5

title: yt-dlp hard-depends on Firefox cookies for YouTube auth
description: get_ytdlp_auth_args() returns ['--cookies-from-browser', 'firefox'] unconditionally (added in PR #5 for the SABR 403 fix). Users running the extension from Brave/Chrome/Arc without a Firefox profile that has a YouTube session hit bot-detection failures on every download. Fix idea: try a cookie-source chain (firefox → brave → chrome) or make the source configurable, with a clear error naming the browser it tried.

title: Progress goes stale during runtime BS-RoFormer model download
description: If the ~610 MB model isn't in .cache/ (install.sh pre-download skipped/offline), the worker writes 'Downloading AI model (one-time)...' once, then nothing until download finishes. read_progress() marks jobs stale after 600 s without updates (centrifugue_host.py), so slow connections show 'Job appears to have stalled' while the download is healthy. Fix: parse audio-separator's download progress lines (tqdm) into write_progress updates, or periodically touch the progress file during Stage 1 startup.

title: Visually verify 3-option quality row in both extension UIs
description: PR #6 adds a third quality option (Ultra) to the floating panel and popup in extension/ (Firefox MV2) and extension-chrome/ (Brave/Chrome MV3). Flex layout should fit three across in the 340px popup, but this hasn't been eyeballed in a real browser. Load both extensions, confirm Fast/Detailed/Ultra render un-clipped and selection works, in the popup and the on-page floating menu.

title: Remove stray personal PDF from extension/
description: extension/'Download Documents - Business Entities Online - S.C. Secretary of State.pdf' is a personal document accidentally saved into the repo working tree (untracked; it briefly got staged into a commit during UI work and was removed by amend). Move it out of the repo so it can't be committed or shipped with the unpacked extension.

title: Ultra fallback output keeps '(Ultra)' folder label and quality metadata
description: When the hybrid Stage 1 fails and the worker falls back to a plain htdemucs_ft run, the output folder is still named '<title> - Stems (Ultra)' and progress reports quality=ultra, but the contents are Detailed-quality MP3s. Observed in real fallback during testing. Fix: when fallback engages, switch the folder suffix/progress quality to balanced (or add a marker) so the output is honest about what ran.
